question:
**Select the word that is opposite in meaning (ANTONYM) to the word given below.**

Frighten
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e.** 'Reassure'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word that is opposite in meaning to **"Frighten"** is **"Reassure".**
 
• **"Frighten"** means to make someone afraid or anxious.(डराना)
